# libreoffice-mcp — Full LLM Reference

## Architecture

FastMCP 3.3 MCP server (stdio + HTTP `/mcp`) + FastAPI REST backend + Vite/React SOTA webapp.

## MCP tools

- libreoffice(operation, …) — portmanteau (see below)
- libreoffice_help(topic?) — help index
- libreoffice_agentic_workflow(goal, ctx) — SEP-1577 sampling workflow
- show_libreoffice_status_card — Prefab UI
- show_templates_card — Prefab UI

## Prompts

libreoffice_quick_start, libreoffice_coworker_pdf, libreoffice_convert_playbook

## Skills

skill://libreoffice-expert/SKILL.md, skill://coworker-pdf/SKILL.md

## Tool: libreoffice(operation, …)

Operations:
- status — soffice path + extension bridge health
- convert — headless convert; .md → HTML → PDF; optional queue_job
- merge — ODT template {{PLACEHOLDER}} → pdf/odt
- list_templates — bundled + custom templates
- batch_pack — multiple .md → single PDF
- bridge_discover — list tools on extension MCP :8765
- bridge_call — proxy to live Writer/Calc extension
- help — capabilities + REST routes

## Bundled templates

fleet-report.odt → coworker_weekly_report_pdf
fleet-board-pack.odt → coworker_board_pack
fleet-artifact-pack.odt → coworker_artifact_pack

## Environment

LIBREOFFICE_MCP_SOFFICE_PATH
LIBREOFFICE_MCP_EXTENSION_BRIDGE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp)
LIBREOFFICE_MCP_TEMPLATES_DIR
LIBREOFFICE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
LIBREOFFICE_MCP_CENTRAL_DOCS_PATH — Apps Hub registry
LIBREOFFICE_MCP_OLLAMA_BASE_URL
LIBREOFFICE_MCP_OLLAMA_MODEL
LIBREOFFICE_MCP_LMSTUDIO_BASE_URL
LIBREOFFICE_MCP_OPENAI_API_KEY
LIBREOFFICE_MCP_OPENAI_MODEL
LIBREOFFICE_MCP_SAMPLING_BASE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1)
LIBREOFFICE_MCP_SAMPLING_MODEL
LIBREOFFICE_MCP_SAMPLING_USE_CLIENT_LLM
LIBREOFFICE_MCP_PREFAB_APPS

## Ports

Backend 10981 | Frontend 10983 | Extension bridge 8765

## Host

LibreOffice 26.2.3.2+ recommended on Windows (soffice.exe).
